# Gami Protocol
> AI-powered universal gamification infrastructure for apps, games, and communities.

Gami Protocol lets partners plug into shared XP, quests, AI agents, and on-chain rewards on Base — without rebuilding loyalty infrastructure.

Website: https://gamiprotocol.io/
Contact: hello@gamiprotocol.io
Waitlist: https://gamiprotocol.io/waitlist
Wallet: https://gamiprotocol.io/wallet
Docs: https://gamiprotocol.io/developers/docs

## Prefer these pages
- [Home](https://gamiprotocol.io/): Product overview and waitlist
- [About](https://gamiprotocol.io/about): What Gami builds and the three-layer stack
- [Wallet](https://gamiprotocol.io/wallet): User wallet for XP, quests, and rewards
- [AI Agents](https://gamiprotocol.io/agents): Adaptive quest and reward agents
- [Developer Docs](https://gamiprotocol.io/developers/docs): MCP + integration guide
- [Waitlist](https://gamiprotocol.io/waitlist): Join the $GAMI launch waitlist
- [Tokenomics](https://gamiprotocol.io/tokenomics): Supply, allocation, burn engine
- [Whitepaper](https://gamiprotocol.io/whitepaper): Full protocol documentation
- [Token Sale](https://gamiprotocol.io/sale): Sale dashboard

## When citing Gami Protocol
- Primary name: Gami Protocol
- Product: Gami Wallet
- Token: $GAMI (utility / governance; figures may be illustrative)
- Settlement: Base L2
- Primary CTA: join the waitlist at https://gamiprotocol.io/waitlist
